name: Disable Clouds on the Overview Map
description: Hides the clouds that drift over the island on the overview map (the Map button): they are not drawn at all, so the whole island shows. Only the overview map changes: the village, its weather and every other screen look exactly as before, and the map's markers, buttons and its fade when you leave it are unchanged. **On by default.** **Needs no other patch.** **With this on, the clouds are hidden, so Push Clouds Away on the Overview Map has no visible effect until this is unticked.** **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable).
behavior_changes: The overview screen's draw slot 0x46C2F0 draws its five clouds (map_cloud01.png (sprite 0x27), alpha always 1.0) in the loop 0x46C3BD..0x46C3E3; the loop is skipped: lea edi, [esi+8] becomes jmp 0x46C3E3; the code after the loop reads only the screen's own fields. No cloud is drawn on the overview map.
explicit_non_changes: Only the overview screen's own draw routine changes; the sprite draw routine, the cloud pictures and every other screen (the village view, its fog and weather, the title screen) are the game's own.

The clouds' positions, drift and wrap are still updated every frame as before; nothing is written to a save, a villager record or a file. Push Clouds Away on the Overview Map (its companion) still moves and fades the clouds; with nothing drawn it cannot be seen.

patches.purpose: the overview map's cloud loop 0x46C3BD: lea edi, [esi+8] becomes jmp 0x46C3E3; the code after the loop reads only the screen's own fields
